questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting / multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

(40, 120, 400)

(18, 20, 78)
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Logic: (First number × 1) + (Second number × 3) = Third number.**

1) (40, 120, 400)

⇒ (40 × 1) + (120 × 3) 

⇒ 40 + 360 = 400

And,

2) (18, 20, 78)

⇒ (18 × 1) + (20 × 3)

⇒ 18 + 60 = 78

Similarly,

3) (29, 23, 98)

⇒ (29 × 1) + (23 × 3)

⇒ 29 + 69 = 98

Hence, the correct answer is **"(29, 23, 98)".**

Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some white are car.

II. No truck is car.

I. All truck are white.

II. Some car are white.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows

Conclusion:

I. All truck are white → **Does not follow **→ As some white are car and no truck is car. So all trucks are white is not possible because some part of white is car. So it is incorrect.

II. Some car are white → **Follow **→ As some white are car. So some car are white is followed. 

So, Only conclusion II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1".**

questions.question: Select the odd group of numbers. (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g.13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /subtracting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed)

By interchanging the given two signs and numbers which of the following equation will be not correct?

× and –, 8 and 4

I. 4 + 3× 8 – 2 ÷ 1 = 3

II. 8 × 2 – 4 + 6 ÷ 2 = 11
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

**Given: **× and –, 8 and 4

After interchanging the sign and number we get the;

1) 4 + 3 × 8 – 2 ÷ 1 = 3

⇒ 8 + 3 - 4 × __**2 ÷ 1 **__= 3

⇒ 8 + 3 - __**4 × 2 **__= 3

⇒ __**8 + 3**__ - 8 = 3

⇒ __**11 - 8 **__= 3

⇒ 3 = 3 (This equation is correct)

2) 8 × 2 – 4 + 6 ÷ 2 = 11

⇒ 4 - 2 × 8 + __**6 ÷ 2**__ = 11 

⇒ 4 - __**2 × 8**__ + 3 = 11

⇒ __**4**__ - 16 __**+ 3 **__= 11

⇒ 7 - 16 = 11

⇒ - 9 ≠ 11 (This equation is not correct)

So, only the equation II is incorrect.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only II".**
